words.en: A whiner is someone who complains a lot in an annoying way.

words.tr:
v. 祝愿；希望；
n. 祝福；愿望；
words.ex: I wish you a happy birthday.
words.ex_cn: 我祝愿你生日快乐。
words.en: If you wish to do something or you wish to have it done for you, you want to do it or have it done.

words.ex: He drinks whiskey after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭后喝威士忌。
words.en: Whiskey is a type of strong alcoholic drink made from grain, especially barley or rye.

words.tr: n. 小装置；小器械；装饰品；窗口小部件
words.ex: The software includes a variety of customizable widgets.
words.ex_cn: 该软件包括各种可定制的小部件。
words.en: A widget is a small device or tool that is used for a particular purpose, or a small application that can be added to a website or computer desktop to provide additional functionality.

words.tr: n. 意外之财；意外的收获；风吹落的果子
words.ex: He got a windfall from his uncle's inheritance.
words.ex_cn: 他从叔叔的遗产中获得了一笔意外之财。
words.en: A windfall is an unexpected gain, piece of good fortune, or financial benefit.

words.ex: She was accused of practicing witchcraft.
words.ex_cn: 她被指控施行巫术。
words.en: Witchcraft is the use of magical powers, especially for evil purposes.

words.tr: n. 怀俄明州（美国的一个州）
words.ex: Wyoming is known for its vast open spaces and natural beauty.
words.ex_cn: 怀俄明州以其广阔的开阔地和自然美景而闻名。
words.en: A state in the western United States, known for its mountainous terrain and low population density.

words.tr: n.定公制; 岗位责任制
words.ex: The engineer used a workset to measure the length.
words.ex_cn: 工程师使用定公制来测量长度。
words.en: A set of tasks or work items to be completed, often used in project management contexts.

words.tr: n. 施乐复印机（商标名称）；
words.ex: He used the xerox to copy his resume.
words.ex_cn: 他用施乐复印机复印了他的简历。
words.en: To make a copy of a document, picture, etc. using a special machine.

words.ex: They sailed on a yacht during their vacation.
words.ex_cn: 他们在假期乘游艇航行。
words.en: A yacht is a medium-sized sailboat used for racing or cruising.

words.tr: n. 美国佬；（美国人中的）北方佬
words.ex: The yankee bought a hot dog at the stadium.
words.ex_cn: 那个美国人在体育场买了一个热狗。
words.en: A Yankee is a term used to refer to an American, especially someone from the northern United States.

words.tr:
n. 轭；枷锁；束缚
v. 上轭；使强行结合
words.ex: The farmer put a yoke on the oxen.
words.ex_cn: 农夫给牛套上了轭。
words.en: A yoke is a wooden bar that is fastened over the necks of two animals, especially cattle, and connected to the vehicle or load that they are pulling. It can also refer to something that binds people together or something that people find oppressive.

words.tr: n. 西兰（新西兰的北岛）
words.ex: He visited Zealand last summer.
words.ex_cn: 他去年夏天去了西兰。
words.en: Zealand is the largest and most populous island in Denmark. It is also the name formerly used for New Zealand, which was named after the Dutch province of Zeeland.

words.tr: n. 兴致；热情；趣味；（用于调味的）柠檬皮；橙皮
words.ex: He cooks with zest and loves spicy food.
words.ex_cn: 他做菜很有激情，喜欢辣的食物。
words.en: Great enthusiasm and energy.

words.tr: n. 苏黎世（瑞士最大的城市）
words.ex: Zurich is one of the most important financial centers in the world.
words.ex_cn: 苏黎世是世界最重要的金融中心之一。
words.en: A city in northern Switzerland, known for its financial institutions and as a cultural center.

words.tr:
n. 之字形；锯齿形；
adj. 之字形的；曲折的；锯齿形的；
words.ex: The road makes a zigzag up the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 这条路沿着山呈之字形向上延伸。
words.en: A zigzag is a line that has a series of angles in it, like a continuous series of 'W's. It can also describe a path or route that proceeds by sharp turns in alternating directions.

words.ex: The zoo has a zoological garden for rare animals.
words.ex_cn: 这个动物园有一个动物学花园，用于展示稀有动物。
words.en: Relating to the scientific study of animals.

chapters.name: 附录 常考短语

words.tr: 短语. 一个恰当的例子；恰如其分的例证
words.ex: He never studies, and fails every test — a case in point.
words.ex_cn: 他从不学习，每次考试都挂科——这就是一个恰当的例子。
words.en: A case in point is a clear and appropriate example that supports or illustrates a point being made.

words.ex: Above all, be kind to others.
words.ex_cn: 最重要的是，对他人要善良。
words.en: Most importantly; especially.

words.ex: He didn't win, but after all, he tried his best.
words.ex_cn: 他没有赢，但毕竟他尽了最大努力。
words.en: You use after all when you are saying that something that you thought might not be the case is in fact the case.

words.tr: phrase. 几乎；差一点；除…外其余都
words.ex: He is all but finished with his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他几乎已经做完了作业。
words.en: All but means almost or nearly. It is used to indicate that something is very close to being the case but not completely so.

words.tr: phrase. 总的来说；整体而言
words.ex: All in all, the trip was fun and cheap.
words.ex_cn: 总的来说，这次旅行又好玩又便宜。
words.en: When you say all in all, you are summarizing a situation or expressing a general opinion about it.

words.ex: He walked all the way to school.
words.ex_cn: 他一路走到学校。
words.en: From the beginning to the end; completely.

words.ex: I thought he was late, but as a matter of fact, he is early.
words.ex_cn: 我以为他迟到了，但事实上，他来早了。
words.en: You use as a matter of fact to introduce a statement that gives more details about what has just been said, or an explanation of it, or something that contrasts with it.

words.tr: phrase. 远到；至于；直到；就…而言
words.ex: The river flows as far as the next town.
words.ex_cn: 这条河一直流到下一个城镇。
words.en: used to indicate the extent or degree of something

words.ex: As for homework, I finished it yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 至于作业，我昨天就完成了。
words.en: used to start talking about someone or something

words.tr: phrase. 至于； 关于；按着；根据
words.ex: I don't know as to when he will come.
words.ex_cn: 我不知道他什么时候来。
words.en: Used to indicate what something is about or concerns.

words.tr: phrase. 好像...似的； 仿佛...一样
words.ex: He talks as if he knows everything.
words.ex_cn: 他说话的样子好像什么都知道。
words.en: used to describe how someone or something appears or behaves, suggesting that the appearance or behavior is not real or true

words.tr: phrase. 好像...似的； 仿佛...一样
words.ex: He talks as though he knows everything.
words.ex_cn: 他说话的样子好像什么都知道。
words.en: used to describe how someone or something seems to be, or how someone behaves, when this is not the real situation

words.tr: phrase. 照现在的样子；实际上
words.ex: We thought things would get better, but as it is, they are getting worse.
words.ex_cn: 我们以为情况会好转，但事实上，情况正在恶化。
words.en: In the actual circumstances; in reality.

words.tr: phrase. 可以说；在某种程度上
words.ex: He was, as it were, a walking encyclopedia.
words.ex_cn: 他可以说是活生生的百科全书。
words.en: Used to indicate that a word or statement is perhaps not exact though practically right.

words.ex: He will call me as soon as he arrives.
words.ex_cn: 他一到就会给我打电话。
words.en: At the moment that; immediately after.

words.ex: He can play the guitar as well as sing.
words.ex_cn: 他既能弹吉他也能唱歌。
words.en: In addition to; and also; equally with.

words.ex: He likes coffee, and he likes tea as well.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢咖啡，也喜欢茶。
words.en: In addition to something else; also.

words.tr: phrase. 只要；长达；和 ... 一样长
words.ex: You can stay out as long as you come home before midnight.
words.ex_cn: 只要你午夜前回家，你就可以在外面待着。
words.en: used to say that one thing is true or will happen only if another thing is true or happens

words.ex: You can go out so long as you finish your homework.
words.ex_cn: 只要你做完作业，就可以出去。
words.en: provided that; on condition that

words.tr: phrase. 无论如何；总之；不管怎样
words.ex: At all events, he will come to the party.
words.ex_cn: 无论如何，他都会来参加派对。
words.en: In any case; whatever happens.

words.ex: I don't like coffee at all.
words.ex_cn: 我一点也不喜欢咖啡。
words.en: Used to emphasize a negative statement, meaning 'in any way' or 'to any extent'.

words.ex: He is about to leave the house.
words.ex_cn: 他马上就要离开家了。
words.en: If you are about to do something, you are going to do it very soon.

words.tr: 表示即将做某事，马上就要做某事
words.ex: I was about to leave when the phone rang.
words.ex_cn: 我正要离开时电话响了。
words.en: If you are about to do something, you are going to do it very soon.

words.tr: phrase. 突然离开； 突然挣脱；决裂； 退出
words.ex: He broke away from the group and ran home.
words.ex_cn: 他突然离开团队，跑回家了。
words.en: To leave or escape from a person, group, or situation that controls or restricts you.

words.tr: phrase. 停止运转；出故障；分解；感情失控
words.ex: The machine broke down yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器昨天坏了。
words.en: If a machine or vehicle breaks down, it stops working. If a discussion, relationship, or system breaks down, it fails because of a problem or disagreement.

words.ex: The thief tried to break into the house at night.
words.ex_cn: 小偷试图在夜里闯入房子。
words.en: To enter a building or car using force, in order to steal something; to suddenly start doing something.

words.tr: phrase. 闯入；打断；（使）逐渐适用
words.ex: Thieves broke in through the back door.
words.ex_cn: 小偷从后门闯入。
words.en: To enter a building by force, especially in order to steal something; to interrupt a conversation or activity.

words.tr: phrase. 中断；突然停止；断绝（关系）；休息一会
words.ex: He broke off the conversation when the phone rang.
words.ex_cn: 电话响时，他中断了对话。
words.en: To suddenly stop doing something, especially speaking.

words.ex: The fire broke out in the kitchen.
words.ex_cn: 火在厨房里突然烧了起来。
words.en: If something such as war, fighting, or disease breaks out, it begins suddenly.

words.ex: He broke through the wall with his hands.
words.ex_cn: 他用手打破了墙壁。
words.en: To break through means to make a way through a barrier or to achieve success in spite of difficulties.

words.tr: phrase. 打碎；分裂；解体；结束；期终放假
words.ex: He broke up the ice with a hammer.
words.ex_cn: 他用锤子把冰打碎了。
words.en: To end a relationship or to disintegrate into pieces.

words.ex: Hard work can bring about success.
words.ex_cn: 努力工作可以带来成功。
words.en: To cause something to happen.

words.ex: He brought his friend around to the new idea slowly.
words.ex_cn: 他慢慢地让朋友接受了这个新想法。
words.en: To persuade someone to agree with you or to do what you want; to cause someone to regain consciousness; to cause someone to change their opinion or decision.

words.ex: He brought round his friend to agree with him.
words.ex_cn: 他说服了他的朋友同意他的观点。
words.en: To cause someone to become conscious again after being unconscious; to persuade someone to agree with a particular opinion or to do something.

words.ex: The new policy will bring down prices.
words.ex_cn: 新政策将降低价格。
words.en: To cause something to fall or collapse; to reduce the level or amount of something; to cause someone in a position of power to lose their position.

words.tr: phrase. 提出；产生；生出；使显现
words.ex: He brought forth a new idea in the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议上提出了一个新想法。
words.en: To bring forth means to produce or cause something to happen or exist.

words.tr: phrase. 提出；提前；把…带上前来
words.ex: He will bring forward a new idea at the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他将在会议上提出一个新想法。
words.en: To bring forward means to move an event or date to an earlier time, or to introduce a topic or proposal for discussion.

words.tr: phrase. 使发挥作用；引入使用；启动
words.ex: The new policy will bring into play the potential of all employees.
words.ex_cn: 新政策将发挥所有员工的潜力。
words.en: To cause something to start to have an effect or to be used.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 成功完成（困难的事情）；使（计划、交易等）成功
words.ex: He brought off the magic show with great skill.
words.ex_cn: 他以高超的技巧完成了这场魔术表演。
words.en: To successfully achieve something difficult.

words.ex: The heat can bring on a headache.
words.ex_cn: 炎热会引发头痛。
words.en: To cause something to happen or to lead to a particular situation.

words.tr: phrase. 使表现出；说出；呈出；出版
words.ex: The new lighting really brings out the colors in the painting.
words.ex_cn: 新灯光让画中的颜色更加突出。
words.en: To cause something to be seen or known; to publish something.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 使……渡过难关；帮助……康复；成功救治
words.ex: The doctor worked hard to bring the patient through the surgery.
words.ex_cn: 医生努力让病人顺利度过手术。
words.en: To help someone survive a difficult period or to recover from an illness.

words.ex: The nurse poured cold water on his face to bring him to.
words.ex_cn: 护士往他脸上泼了冷水，让他苏醒过来。
words.en: To cause someone to regain consciousness or to become aware of something.

words.tr: phrase. 提出；教育；养育；呕出
words.ex: He brought up an important point in the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议上提出了一个重要的观点。
words.en: To mention a subject or start to talk about it; to care for a child until they are an adult, often giving them particular beliefs; to educate someone; to vomit.

words.tr: phrase. 把……建造进；把……纳入设计中；使成为……的组成部分
words.ex: They build extra storage into the new school desks.
words.ex_cn: 他们把额外的储物空间设计进了新的课桌里。
words.en: To make something an integral part of a system, structure, or product.

words.ex: The phone has a built-in camera.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机有内置摄像头。
words.en: A built-in device or feature is one that is included as part of a larger system or structure, rather than being separate.

words.tr: phrase. 建立于；以…为基础；指望
words.ex: He built on his old ideas to make a new plan.
words.ex_cn: 他基于旧的想法制定了一个新计划。
words.en: To develop or increase something from a particular starting point or base.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 在……基础上发展；以……为起点进行建设或改进
words.ex: He built upon his earlier work to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他基于之前的工作解决了这个问题。
words.en: To develop or improve something by using or adding to something that already exists.

words.tr: phrase. 建立；逐步增长；加强
words.ex: He builds up his strength by running every day.
words.ex_cn: 他通过每天跑步来增强体力。
words.en: To increase or develop something gradually; to accumulate or amass something over time.

words.tr:
conj. 但是；然而；
prep. 除…以外；
adv. 只能；仅仅；
words.ex: I like apples, but I don't like oranges.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢苹果，但是我不喜欢橙子。
words.en: used to introduce a phrase or clause contrasting with what has already been mentioned

words.tr: phrase. 尽一切办法；务必；一定
words.ex: You can borrow my book by all means.
words.ex_cn: 你当然可以借我的书。
words.en: used to give permission or to say that you are willing to allow something to happen

words.tr: phrase. …得多；尤其；更；到目前为止
words.ex: This is by far the best movie I have seen.
words.ex_cn: 这绝对是我看过的最好的电影。
words.en: By far is used to emphasize that something is the best, worst, biggest, etc., of its kind.

words.ex: He cleaned the floor by means of a mop.
words.ex_cn: 他用拖把打扫了地板。
words.en: If you do something by means of a particular method, instrument, or process, you do it using that method, instrument, or process.

words.ex: He is by no means lazy.
words.ex_cn: 他绝对不懒。
words.en: You use 'by no means' to emphasize that something is not true or is definitely not the case.

words.tr: phrase. 顺便说说；顺便提起
words.ex: By the way, I saw your brother yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 对了，我昨天看到你弟弟了。
words.en: used to introduce a comment or question that is not directly related to the main subject of conversation

words.ex: He laughs and cries by turns.
words.ex_cn: 他一会儿笑，一会儿哭。
words.en: If people do something by turns, they do it one after the other in a repeated order.

words.ex: He sent the letter by way of his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他通过朋友寄了这封信。
words.en: If you do something by way of a particular method, you use that method to do it.

words.ex: He received a callback after the interview.
words.ex_cn: 面试后他收到了回叫信号。
words.en: A callback is a telephone call that you make to someone who has called you, or a function that is passed as an argument to another function and is executed after some event has occurred.

words.tr: phrase. 呼吁；号召；要求；接（人）
words.ex: The situation calls for immediate action.
words.ex_cn: 这种情况需要立即采取行动。
words.en: If you call for something, you demand that it should happen.

words.tr: phrase. 叫（某人）进来；召来；来访
words.ex: He called in a doctor for his sick son.
words.ex_cn: 他为生病的儿子请了一位医生。
words.en: To request someone's presence or participation, especially by telephone.

words.tr: phrase. 取消；转移；叫走；依次叫名
words.ex: They decided to call off the meeting because of the storm.
words.ex_cn: 他们因为风暴决定取消会议。
words.en: To cancel or abandon something that was planned.

words.tr: phrase. 拜访；要求；呼吁；号召
words.ex: I will call on my grandma this weekend.
words.ex_cn: 这个周末我将去拜访我的奶奶。
words.en: To visit someone; to formally ask or request someone to do something.

words.tr: phrase. 拜访；要求；呼吁；号召
words.ex: I will call upon my grandmother this weekend.
words.ex_cn: 这个周末我会去拜访我的祖母。
words.en: To call upon someone is to ask them to do something or to use something that they can offer.

words.tr: phrase. 给…打电话；使想起；召集
words.ex: He called up his friend to say hello.
words.ex_cn: 他给朋友打电话问好。
words.en: To telephone someone; to summon someone to military service; to bring something back to one's mind.

words.tr: phrase. 结转；转下期；转冲（下年度应税损益）；发扬
words.ex: The company will carry forward the loss to next year.
words.ex_cn: 公司会将亏损结转到下一年。
words.en: To transfer an amount from one accounting period to the next; to continue or extend something.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 成功地处理或应对（困难或尴尬的情况）；夺走；使显得有魅力
words.ex: He carried off the awkward silence with a joke.
words.ex_cn: 他用一个笑话成功应对了尴尬的沉默。
words.en: To succeed in doing or achieving something, especially something difficult.

words.tr: phrase. 继续；坚持；进行；开展
words.ex: He will carry on working after lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午饭后会继续工作。
words.en: If you carry on, you continue doing something.

words.ex: They will carry out the experiment tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他们明天将进行这个实验。
words.en: To perform or complete a task, duty, or project.

words.ex: We can carry over the unused vacation days to next year.
words.ex_cn: 我们可以把未用完的假期天数延到明年。
words.en: To transfer or extend something from one time or place to another.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 坚持到底；完成；帮助某人渡过难关
words.ex: He worked hard to carry through his plan.
words.ex_cn: 他努力实施他的计划。
words.en: To complete something or to continue doing something until it is finished, especially something difficult.

words.tr: phrase. v. 试图抓住；急切地抓住（机会、希望等）
words.ex: He tried to catch at the rope as it slipped away.
words.ex_cn: 当绳子滑走时，他试图抓住它。
words.en: To try to seize or grasp something eagerly.

words.tr: phrase. 理解；明白；变得流行
words.ex: He didn't understand the joke at first, but then he caught on.
words.ex_cn: 他一开始没明白这个笑话，但后来明白了。
words.en: To understand or become popular.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 使某人措手不及；发现某人做错事；使某人陷入困境
words.ex: The teacher's question caught me out because I didn't study.
words.ex_cn: 老师的问题让我措手不及，因为我没学习。
words.en: To discover someone doing something wrong or making a mistake, especially when they are trying to deceive you.

words.tr: phrase. 赶上；逮捕并处罚；（麻烦事）缠上
words.ex: He needs to catch up with his classmates.
words.ex_cn: 他需要赶上他的同学。
words.en: To reach the same standard or level as someone or something else, especially after a period of lagging behind.

words.ex: He checks in at the hotel at 3 PM.
words.ex_cn: 他在下午三点办理入住。
words.en: To announce your arrival, especially at a hotel or an airport, by signing your name or showing your ticket.

words.ex: We checked out of the hotel after paying the bill.
words.ex_cn: 我们付完账后离开了酒店。
words.en: To check out means to leave a hotel after paying your bill, or to examine something or someone in order to be certain that everything is correct, safe, or satisfactory.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 检查；核查；（尤指为发现疾病或问题而）进行健康检查
words.ex: The doctor will check up on you tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 医生明天会给你做检查。
words.en: To examine something or someone in order to discover if there are any problems or to find out more information.

words.ex: The manager checks on the workers every hour.
words.ex_cn: 经理每小时监督工人们。
words.en: To verify or ensure the condition or status of something or someone.

words.ex: She decided to clean out the garage this weekend.
words.ex_cn: 她决定这个周末打扫车库。
words.en: To clean out means to remove everything from a place and clean it thoroughly.

words.tr: phrase. 打扫干净；收拾整洁
words.ex: They clean up the room every Saturday.
words.ex_cn: 他们每星期六打扫房间。
words.en: To make a place or thing clean and tidy by removing dirt, rubbish, or unwanted items.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 清理；清除；收拾
words.ex: He will clear away the toys from the floor.
words.ex_cn: 他会把地上的玩具清理掉。
words.en: To remove items or obstacles from a place so that it is tidy or unobstructed.

words.tr: phrase. 清除；摆脱；走开；消散
words.ex: Clear off the table before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 晚饭前把桌子收拾干净。
words.en: To leave a place quickly or to remove something completely.

words.tr: phrase. 清除；把…清出；（使）离开
words.ex: He will clear out the old boxes from the garage.
words.ex_cn: 他会把旧箱子从车库清理出去。
words.en: To remove items from a place to make it clean and empty.

words.tr: phrase. 清理；澄清；解决；放晴
words.ex: He helped to clear up the toys after playtime.
words.ex_cn: 他帮忙在玩完后收拾玩具。
words.en: To remove things that are causing a mess or obstruction; to explain something that was unclear; for the weather to become fine.

words.ex: How did this mistake come about?
words.ex_cn: 这个错误是怎么发生的？
words.en: If you ask how something came about, you want to know how it happened or started.

words.tr: phrase. 偶遇；偶然发现；使产生…印象
words.ex: I came across an old photo while cleaning my room.
words.ex_cn: 我在打扫房间时发现了一张旧照片。
words.en: If you come across something or someone, you find them or meet them by chance.

words.tr: phrase. 出现；跟随；进步；（催促）赶快
words.ex: I didn't see him, but he came along later.
words.ex_cn: 我没看到他，但他后来出现了。
words.en: To appear or arrive, often unexpectedly; to make progress or improve.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 分离；散架；崩溃；瓦解
words.ex: The toy car came apart when I dropped it.
words.ex_cn: 我的玩具车掉下来的时候散架了。
words.en: If something comes apart, it breaks into pieces or parts.

words.tr: phrase. v. （观点或态度）改变，回心转意；顺便来访，顺道拜访；苏醒，恢复知觉
words.ex: At first he refused, but later he came around and agreed to help.
words.ex_cn: 他一开始拒绝了，但后来回心转意，同意帮忙。
words.en: To change one's opinion or decision; to regain consciousness; to visit someone casually.

words.tr: phrasal verb. （观点或态度）转变，改变主意；（身体或情绪上）恢复；顺便来访，过来
words.ex: He didn't want to help at first, but he came round after we talked.
words.ex_cn: 他一开始不想帮忙，但经过交谈后改变了主意。
words.en: To regain consciousness; to change one's opinion or position; to visit someone casually.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 向…扑来；攻击；指责；接近（某事物）
words.ex: The dog came at me with barking.
words.ex_cn: 那只狗冲我扑过来，边叫边冲。
words.en: To move towards someone or something in a threatening way; to reach or achieve something.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 介入…之间；离间；妨碍（关系或进程）
words.ex: He tried to come between them, but failed.
words.ex_cn: 他试图离间他们，但失败了。
words.en: To prevent people from having a good relationship with each other.

words.tr: phrase. v. 获得；设法得到；顺道来访
words.ex: I came by some old books at the flea market.
words.ex_cn: 我在跳蚤市场弄到了一些旧书。
words.en: To obtain or acquire something, especially something that is not easily available.

words.tr: phrase. 可归结为；屈尊做某事
words.ex: It will come down to who works harder.
words.ex_cn: 这将取决于谁更努力。
words.en: If a problem, decision, or question comes down to a particular thing, that thing is the most important factor involved.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 下来；下降；流传；病倒
words.ex: The price of apples came down last week.
words.ex_cn: 上周苹果的价格降了。
words.en: To move or travel from a higher to a lower level or position; to descend.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 受到（批评、赞扬等）；招致
words.ex: He came in for criticism after the mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他因这个错误而受到了批评。
words.en: If someone or something comes in for criticism, blame, or praise, they receive it.

words.tr: phrase. 离开；举行；实现；成功；从…掉下
words.ex: He will come off the train at the next station.
words.ex_cn: 他将在下一站下车。
words.en: To happen or occur, especially in a particular way; to be successful or effective.

words.tr: phrase. 加油；快点；拜托；来吧；开始
words.ex: Come on, you can finish this race!
words.ex_cn: 加油，你能跑完这场比赛的！
words.en: Used to encourage someone to do something or to hurry up, or to express disbelief or skepticism.

words.ex: The sun comes out after the rain.
words.ex_cn: 雨停后太阳出来了。
words.en: If something comes out, it becomes known, especially after it has been kept secret or it has been unknown.

words.tr: phrase. 到达；显现；实现；成功地完成；（健康）恢复；渡过
words.ex: The package will come through tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 包裹明天会到达。
words.en: To successfully deal with a difficult situation or to do what is needed or expected.

words.tr: phrase. 苏醒；到达；总计；突然想起
words.ex: He came to after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 事故后他醒了过来。
words.en: If someone comes to, they regain consciousness after being unconscious. It can also mean to reach a particular state or condition, or to be involved in something.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 面对；遭遇（困难、反对等）
words.ex: He came up against a big problem while solving the math question.
words.ex_cn: 他在解这道数学题时遇到了一个大问题。
words.en: To encounter or face difficulties or opposition.

words.ex: The temperature came up to 30 degrees yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 昨天温度升到了30度。
words.en: To reach a particular standard or level; to be as good as expected.

words.ex: He ran fast to come up with the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得很快，以便赶上公交车。
words.en: If you come up with a plan, idea, or solution, you think of it and suggest it.

words.ex: A problem came up during the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 会议期间发生了一个问题。
words.en: To arise or occur, especially unexpectedly or as a subject of discussion.

words.tr: phrasal verb. （对某人或某事不利）被算作不利因素；对…有负面影响
words.ex: His age could count against him in the job interview.
words.ex_cn: 他的年龄可能在面试中对他不利。
words.en: If something counts against you, it may cause you to be rejected or punished, or make people think you are less suitable for something.

words.ex: The kids are watching the countdown to New Year.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们正在观看新年的倒计时。
words.en: A countdown is the counting aloud of numbers in reverse order before something happens, especially before a spacecraft is launched.

words.tr: phrase. （音乐开始前打拍子）开始计数；把…包括在内
words.ex: The teacher will count in before the choir sings.
words.ex_cn: 合唱团唱歌前，老师会先打拍子计数。
words.en: To include someone in a plan or activity.

words.ex: I can count on my brother to help me.
words.ex_cn: 我可以依靠我哥哥帮我。
words.en: If you count on someone or something, you rely on them to support you or help you.

words.tr: phrase. v. 依靠；指望；信赖
words.ex: You can count upon me to help you.
words.ex_cn: 你可以指望我帮你。
words.en: To rely on someone or something to do what you expect or need.

words.tr: phrase. v. 不把…考虑在内；排除；点数后排除
words.ex: Don't count out the weather when planning the picnic.
words.ex_cn: 计划野餐时，别把天气因素排除在外。
words.en: If you count out a sum of money, you count the notes or coins as you put them in a pile one by one.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 把…加起来；逐一数出
words.ex: He is counting up the coins in his pocket.
words.ex_cn: 他正在数他口袋里的硬币。
words.en: To add up numbers or amounts in order to find the total.

words.tr: phrase. 抄近路通过；越（界）；影响，涉及（不同群体）；违背
words.ex: The path cuts across the field.
words.ex_cn: 这条路穿过田野。
words.en: If an issue or problem cuts across different groups of people, it affects or matters to all those groups.

words.ex: He wants to cut back on sugar.
words.ex_cn: 他想减少糖的摄入。
words.en: To reduce the amount, size, cost, etc. of something.

words.ex: They cut down the old tree in the yard.
words.ex_cn: 他们把院子里那棵老树砍倒了。
words.en: To reduce the amount, size, or number of something, or to do less of something.

words.tr: phrase. 插嘴；打断；超车抢档
words.ex: He cut in while I was talking.
words.ex_cn: 我正在说话时，他插嘴了。
words.en: To interrupt someone who is speaking, or to move into a line of traffic by driving in front of someone else.

words.ex: He cut off the power during the storm.
words.ex_cn: 他在风暴期间切断了电源。
words.en: To stop the supply of something, or to stop something from continuing.

words.ex: He cut out sugar from his diet.
words.ex_cn: 他从饮食中戒掉了糖。
words.en: To remove something by cutting it or to stop doing something.

words.tr: phrase. 消除；终止；废除；杀死；干掉
words.ex: They want to do away with the old rules.
words.ex_cn: 他们想废除旧规则。
words.en: To do away with something means to get rid of it or to stop using it.

words.tr: phrase. 与...相处；忍受；处理；与…有关；需要；想做
words.ex: I don't know how to do with him; he is always quiet.
words.ex_cn: 我不知道怎么和他相处；他总是很安静。
words.en: To have a connection or relevance to a particular subject or situation.

words.ex: We can do without sugar in our coffee.
words.ex_cn: 我们咖啡里可以不加糖。
words.en: To manage or survive without something that one would like to have.

words.tr: phrase. 收（债务）；引诱；（天色）接近黄昏；紧缩（开支）；（车）到站；用...绘画；吸入（气体）；缩短；拉回（网）
words.ex: The bank will draw in the loan next month.
words.ex_cn: 银行下个月将收回贷款。
words.en: To attract or entice someone or something into a place or situation.

words.ex: He draws on his old experience to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他利用自己的旧经验来解决这个问题。
words.en: To make use of something, especially a resource or skill, that one has available.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 利用，凭借（经验、资源等）；动用
words.ex: He draws upon his old experience to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他利用自己的旧经验来解决问题。
words.en: To make use of something, especially a resource or a quality, in order to achieve something.

words.tr: phrase. 草拟；停住；逼近；追上；整队
words.ex: He will draw up a plan tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会起草一个计划。
words.en: To prepare and write something such as a document or plan, or to bring a vehicle to a stop.

words.ex: I will go for a walk even if it rains.
words.ex_cn: 即使下雨，我也会去散步。
words.en: You use 'even if' to say that something is true or happens although something else might prevent it.

words.ex: He went out even though it was raining.
words.ex_cn: 尽管在下雨，他还是出去了。
words.en: You use even though to introduce a clause which gives the reason for something, but which makes the reason seem less important or significant.

words.tr: phrase. 求助于；退到；转而依靠
words.ex: He will fall back on his savings if he loses his job.
words.ex_cn: 如果他失业了，他会依靠自己的储蓄。
words.en: To rely on something or someone for help or support, especially when other options have failed.

words.tr: n. 应急计划，应变计划；减少，削减；储备物，备用物；退路；可依靠之物; adj. 退守的；应变的
words.ex: He used a fallback plan when the first one failed.
words.ex_cn: 当第一个计划失败时，他使用了备用方案。
words.en: A fallback is an alternative plan or course of action that is ready to be used in case the original one is not successful or possible.

words.ex: He fell behind in math because he missed classes.
words.ex_cn: 他因为缺课而数学落下了。
words.en: To fail to keep up with others; to lag behind.

words.tr: phrase. 落入（圈套）；上当；倾心
words.ex: He fell for the scam and lost his money.
words.ex_cn: 他落入了骗局，失去了钱。
words.en: To be deceived by someone or something; to develop a romantic or strong liking for someone or something.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 同意；赞成；与…一致；偶然遇到并结识
words.ex: He fell in with a group of artists when he moved to the city.
words.ex_cn: 他搬到城市后结识了一群艺术家。
words.en: To agree with or accept someone's ideas, plans, or opinions; to meet someone by chance.

words.ex: The robbers fell on the old man at night.
words.ex_cn: 抢劫者在夜里袭击了那位老人。
words.en: If a duty, responsibility, or opportunity falls on someone, it is their duty, responsibility, or opportunity to do something.

words.ex: The robbers fell upon the old man at night.
words.ex_cn: 抢劫者在夜里袭击了那位老人。
words.en: To happen to someone or something, especially something unpleasant, or to attack someone or something suddenly.

words.tr: phrase. 吵架；失和；掉落；离队
words.ex: They fell out over a small argument.
words.ex_cn: 他们因为一个小争执吵翻了。
words.en: If people fall out, they have an argument and are no longer friendly.

words.tr: phrase. v. （计划、安排等）失败，落空，未能实现
words.ex: Their plan to go on vacation will fall through if they don't save enough money.
words.ex_cn: 如果他们没有存够钱，他们的度假计划就会落空。
words.en: If an agreement, plan, or deal falls through, it fails to happen or be completed.

words.ex: The temperature fell to zero last night.
words.ex_cn: 昨晚温度降到了零度。
words.en: If someone falls to doing something, they start doing it.

words.ex: He went out for all it was raining.
words.ex_cn: 尽管在下雨，他还是出去了。
words.en: Despite; used to introduce a fact that makes the main statement in your sentence very surprising

words.tr: 为了某人的缘故；看在某人的份上
words.ex: I did it for your sake.
words.ex_cn: 我为了你才这么做的。
words.en: If you do something for someone's sake, you do it in order to help them or make them happy.

words.tr: phrasal verb. （消息等）传开；（人）走动，外出活动
words.ex: The news about the party got about quickly.
words.ex_cn: 关于派对的消息很快传开了。
words.en: To move around or travel, especially within a community or area.

words.ex: He tried to get across his idea simply.
words.ex_cn: 他试图简单地表达他的想法。
words.en: To succeed in communicating an idea or piece of information to someone, especially when this is difficult or complicated.

words.tr: phrase. v. 取得成功；进步；超越他人
words.ex: He works hard to get ahead in his job.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作以在工作中取得进步。
words.en: To make progress or become successful in one's career or life.

words.ex: They get along well with each other.
words.ex_cn: 他们相处得很好。
words.en: If people get along, they like each other and are friendly to each other.

words.tr: phrase. 避免；绕开；说服；顺利应付
words.ex: He tried to get around the rules by using a loophole.
words.ex_cn: 他试图利用一个漏洞来规避规则。
words.en: To find a way to deal with or avoid a problem; to move or travel from place to place; to become known by many people.

words.tr: phrase. v. 绕过（困难或规则）；说服；传播
words.ex: He managed to get round the problem by finding a different solution.
words.ex_cn: 他通过找到一个不同的解决方案成功地绕过了这个问题。
words.en: To find a way to deal with or avoid a problem; to persuade someone to do something or to agree with you.

words.tr: phrase. 领会；贿赂；查明；够到
words.ex: I don't know what you are getting at.
words.ex_cn: 我不明白你到底想表达什么。
words.en: If you ask someone what they are getting at, you are asking them to explain what they mean, usually because you think they are being unpleasant or are suggesting something that is untrue.

words.ex: The thief tried to get away from the police.
words.ex_cn: 小偷试图逃脱警察。
words.en: If you get away, you succeed in leaving a place or a person's company. If you get away with something, you succeed in doing it without being caught or punished.

words.tr: phrase. 回来；取回；恢复；报复
words.ex: He will get back tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会回来。
words.en: To return to a place, condition, or activity; to recover something lost or taken away; to retaliate.

words.tr: phrase. v. 度过难关；勉强应付；勉强维持生活
words.ex: He gets by with little money.
words.ex_cn: 他靠很少的钱维持生活。
words.en: To manage to live or do a particular thing using the money, knowledge, equipment, etc. that you have.

words.tr: phrase. 下来；吞下；弯下；写下
words.ex: He got down from the chair slowly.
words.ex_cn: 他慢慢地从椅子上下来。
words.en: To move from a higher to a lower position; to write something down; to cause someone to feel sad or depressed.

words.tr: phrase. 进入；陷入；染上（坏习惯）
words.ex: He wants to get into a good university.
words.ex_cn: 他想进入一所好大学。
words.en: To enter or become involved in a particular activity, situation, or state.

words.tr: phrase. 进入；到达；插话；收割；当选
words.ex: He gets in the car every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上上车。
words.en: To arrive at a place, especially after a journey.

words.ex: He gets off the bus at the school.
words.ex_cn: 他在学校下车。
words.en: To leave a place, especially in order to start a journey; to remove something, especially clothing.

words.ex: How is your project getting on?
words.ex_cn: 你的项目进展如何？
words.en: If you get on with someone, you have a friendly relationship with them. If you get on with something, you continue doing it or start doing it.

words.ex: He told the dog to get out.
words.ex_cn: 他让狗出去。
words.en: To leave or escape from a place or situation.

words.ex: He got over his cold last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周康复了。
words.en: To recover from something, such as an illness or a shock; to overcome a problem or difficulty.

words.tr: phrase. 通过；（电话）打通；度过；做完；用完
words.ex: He got through the exam with help from his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他在朋友的帮助下通过了考试。
words.en: To succeed in reaching a place or a stage in a process, or to make someone understand or accept something.

words.ex: We get together every weekend to play basketball.
words.ex_cn: 我们每周末聚在一起打篮球。
words.en: If people get together, they meet in order to spend time with each other.

words.ex: I get up at seven o'clock every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我每天早上七点起床。
words.en: To rise from bed after sleeping; to stand up; to increase in amount or level.

words.tr: phrase. 赠送；分发；背叛；泄露
words.ex: He will give away his old books to the library.
words.ex_cn: 他将把他的旧书捐给图书馆。
words.en: To give something to someone without asking for payment, or to reveal something secret or private.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 归还；回馈；恢复
words.ex: He will give back the book tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会把书还回去。
words.en: If you give something back, you return it to the person who gave it to you or to the person who owns it.

words.ex: He will not give in to the bully.
words.ex_cn: 他不会向欺凌者屈服。
words.en: To agree to something that you had been opposing, especially because someone has forced or persuaded you to.

words.ex: The lamp gives off a warm light.
words.ex_cn: 这盏灯发出温暖的光。
words.en: If something gives off or gives out a gas, heat, or a smell, it produces it and sends it out into the air.

words.tr: phrase. 分发；发出；发表；用尽
words.ex: He gives out books to the students.
words.ex_cn: 他把书分发给学生们。
words.en: To distribute or hand out something; to emit or produce something such as a sound or smell; to announce or make something known publicly.

words.ex: He gave over the room to storage.
words.ex_cn: 他把房间留作储物用途。
words.en: To dedicate or devote something to a particular purpose or person.

words.ex: He gave up smoking last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年戒烟了。
words.en: If you give up something, you stop doing it or having it.

words.tr: phrase. 撤退；让路；退让；屈服；垮塌
words.ex: The soldiers had to give way to the enemy.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们不得不向敌人撤退。
words.en: To yield or surrender; to collapse or fail under pressure.

words.tr: phrase. 着手干；进行；（经常）表现得
words.ex: He goes about his work quietly.
words.ex_cn: 他安静地做自己的工作。
words.en: If you go about a task or problem in a particular way, you start dealing with it in that way.

words.ex: He goes after his dreams every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天追求自己的梦想。
words.en: To pursue or chase someone or something, often with the intention of catching or achieving them.

words.ex: If you go against the rules, you might get in trouble.
words.ex_cn: 如果你违反规定，可能会惹上麻烦。
words.en: To oppose or act in contradiction to something or someone.

words.ex: Go ahead, the path is clear.
words.ex_cn: 前进吧，路是畅通的。
words.en: To proceed or continue with something without hesitation.

words.tr: phrase. 前进； 进行；赞同
words.ex: The car went along the road slowly.
words.ex_cn: 汽车缓慢地沿着路前进。
words.en: To proceed or continue with something, especially a plan or activity; to agree with or support an idea, proposal, etc.

words.tr: 参观; 转动; 走访; 相处
words.ex: We went around the old town last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 上周末我们参观了老城区。
words.en: If you go around to someone's house, you visit them. If a story or piece of information goes around, it is told or passed on to a lot of people. If there is enough of something to go around, there is enough for everyone to have some.

words.tr: phrase. 到处走动；流传；供应
words.ex: The children go round the park every afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们每天下午到处在公园里走动。
words.en: To move from place to place or to be sufficient for everyone.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 向…扑去；攻击；着手处理
words.ex: The dog went at the mailman with barking.
words.ex_cn: 那只狗朝邮递员扑了过去。
words.en: To attack or to start doing something with energy.

words.tr: phrase. v. 违背（承诺、协议等）；食言
words.ex: He promised to help, but he went back on his word.
words.ex_cn: 他答应帮忙，但他食言了。
words.en: If you go back on a promise, agreement, or statement, you do not do what you promised or agreed to do, or you say something which is the opposite of what you said earlier.

words.ex: Time goes by quickly when you are happy.
words.ex_cn: 当你开心时，时间过得很快。
words.en: If you say that time goes by, you mean that it passes.

words.tr: phrase. 下沉；坠落；下降；被接受；传下去；被咽下
words.ex: The sun goes down in the evening.
words.ex_cn: 太阳在傍晚落下。
words.en: To move from a higher to a lower place or position; to decrease in size, amount, or intensity; to be accepted or believed; to happen or take place.

words.tr: phrase. 选择；追求；努力争取
words.ex: I want to go for the blue shirt.
words.ex_cn: 我对那件蓝色的衬衫感兴趣。
words.en: If you go for something, you choose it or try to achieve it.

words.tr: phrase. 参加；爱好；从事；赞成
words.ex: He goes in for football every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每个周末都参加足球。
words.en: To participate in or be involved with something; to have a liking for something.

words.ex: He goes into the room quietly.
words.ex_cn: 他悄悄地进入房间。
words.en: To enter a place, to start doing something as a job or activity, to investigate or examine something, or to discuss something in detail.

words.ex: The firework went off at midnight.
words.ex_cn: 烟花在午夜爆炸了。
words.en: If a device or alarm goes off, it starts to ring loudly or make a loud noise. To leave a place, especially in order to do something. To happen in a particular way. To stop liking someone or something. To explode or fire. To decay or become rotten.

words.ex: He goes on talking even when no one listens.
words.ex_cn: 即使没人听，他还是继续说。
words.en: To continue an activity or process, especially after a pause or interruption.

words.tr: phrase. 特意；不辞辛劳地做某事
words.ex: He goes out of his way to help his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他特意去帮助他的朋友们。
words.en: To make a special effort to do something; to inconvenience oneself in order to do something for someone else.

words.ex: They go out to watch a movie on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他们周末外出看电影。
words.en: To leave a place, especially one's home, for a short time, usually for a specific purpose such as entertainment or socializing.

words.tr: phrase. 仔细检查；复习；重做；转向；受欢迎
words.ex: I will go over my homework tonight.
words.ex_cn: 我今晚会复习我的家庭作业。
words.en: To examine or review something carefully; to cross over something.

words.tr: phrase. 经历；仔细检查；完成；通过；穿过
words.ex: He went through a hard time last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年经历了一段艰难的时光。
words.en: To experience something, often something difficult or unpleasant, or to examine or discuss something in detail.

words.tr: phrase. 沉没；死；屈服；失败；破产
words.ex: The boat went under after hitting the rock.
words.ex_cn: 船撞上岩石后沉没了。
words.en: To fail, collapse, or be defeated; to sink or submerge.

words.ex: The price of apples will go up next week.
words.ex_cn: 苹果的价格将在下周上涨。
words.en: If a price, amount, or level goes up, it becomes higher or greater than it was.

words.tr: phrase. v. 没有……也勉强过；在缺乏某物的情况下生活或继续
words.ex: He went without breakfast to save time.
words.ex_cn: 他为了节省时间没吃早餐。
words.en: If you go without something that you need or usually have, you do not get it or have it.

words.tr: phrase. 伴随；与...相配；同…一致
words.ex: I will go with you to the market.
words.ex_cn: 我会和你一起去市场。
words.en: To be suitable or appropriate with something; to accompany something; to exist or occur together with something.

words.tr: phrase. 宁愿；更愿意（用于表示偏好，后接动词原形）
words.ex: I had rather stay at home than go out in the rain.
words.ex_cn: 我宁愿呆在家里，也不愿在雨中外出。
words.en: Would prefer to do something.

words.ex: I would rather stay home than go out in the rain.
words.ex_cn: 我宁愿待在家里也不愿在雨中出去。
words.en: If you say that you would rather do something or you'd rather do it, you mean that you would prefer to do it. If you say that you would rather not do something, you mean that you do not want to do it.

words.ex: My grandmother will hand down her old watch to me.
words.ex_cn: 我的祖母会把她的旧表传给我。
words.en: To pass something from one generation to the next or to officially give a decision or judgment.

words.tr: phrase. 手拉手地；紧密地；同时发生地
words.ex: They walk hand in hand in the park.
words.ex_cn: 他们手拉手在公园里散步。
words.en: If two people are hand in hand, they are holding each other's hand. If two things go hand in hand, they are closely connected and one thing causes the other.

words.tr: phrase. v. 传递；交给（某人）
words.ex: Please hand on the book to your friend.
words.ex_cn: 请把书递给你的朋友。
words.en: To pass something to someone else, especially so that they can take over a responsibility or duty.

words.ex: The teacher will hand out the papers now.
words.ex_cn: 老师现在会分发试卷。
words.en: To distribute something to a group of people.

words.ex: He will hand over the keys tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会交出钥匙。
words.en: To give something to someone else, especially because you have been ordered to do so or because it is necessary.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 闲逛；徘徊；无所事事地待着
words.ex: They like to hang about after school.
words.ex_cn: 他们喜欢放学后闲逛。
words.en: To spend time somewhere without any real purpose or activity.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 闲逛；逗留；在附近徘徊
words.ex: He hangs around the park after school.
words.ex_cn: 他放学后在公园闲逛。
words.en: To spend time somewhere without any particular purpose or activity.

words.tr: phrase. 紧紧握住；坚持下去；保留
words.ex: He hangs on to his old wallet because it reminds him of his dad.
words.ex_cn: 他紧紧保留着旧钱包，因为它让他想起爸爸。
words.en: To keep something that you have, especially because it might be useful or valuable in the future.

words.tr: phrase. 不挂断；稍等 ；紧紧抓住
words.ex: Hang on, I will be there soon.
words.ex_cn: 等一下，我马上就到。
words.en: To hold onto something tightly; to wait for a short time.

words.tr: phrasal verb. （使）团结一致，（使）协调一致；（理论、说法等）前后一致，合乎逻辑
words.ex: The team must hang together to succeed.
words.ex_cn: 团队必须团结一致才能成功。
words.en: If people hang together, they stay with each other and support each other even though they may have different opinions or difficulties.

words.tr: phrase. 挂断；拖延；把...挂起来
words.ex: He hung up the phone after the argument.
words.ex_cn: 争吵后，他挂断了电话。
words.en: To end a telephone conversation by breaking the connection; to suspend something from above so that it is supported only from above.

words.tr: phrase. 阻止；抑制；使退缩；隐瞒
words.ex: He tried to hold back his tears.
words.ex_cn: 他试图忍住眼泪。
words.en: To hold back means to prevent someone or something from moving forward or making progress, or to keep something secret or not express your feelings.

words.tr: phrase. v. 抑制，压制；保住（工作）；按住，使固定
words.ex: Try to hold down your anger.
words.ex_cn: 试着抑制你的愤怒。
words.en: To keep something at a low level or to maintain a position or job despite difficulties.

words.tr: phrase. v. 高谈阔论；滔滔不绝地讲话
words.ex: He likes to hold forth on his travels in the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢大谈他在山里的旅行经历。
words.en: To speak at length or in detail about a particular subject, often in a way that is intended to impress or persuade others.

words.tr: phrase. 紧紧抓住；坚持；保持
words.ex: Please hold on to the handrail when the bus starts.
words.ex_cn: 当公共汽车启动时，请抓紧扶手。
words.en: To hold on to something means to keep it in your possession or to not let it go, often because it is valuable or important to you.

words.tr: phrase. v. 紧紧抓住；坚持不放；保留
words.ex: He holds onto his old bike because it reminds him of his childhood.
words.ex_cn: 他保留着那辆旧自行车，因为它让他想起童年。
words.en: To keep something tightly in one's grasp or to not let go of something, either physically or metaphorically.

words.tr: phrase. 抓紧不放；继续；不挂断；坚持
words.ex: Hold on the rope tightly!
words.ex_cn: 紧紧抓住绳子！
words.en: To continue to do something or to wait for a short time.

words.tr: phrase. 伸出；提供；坚持；抵抗；寄予（希望）
words.ex: He held out his hand to help her up.
words.ex_cn: 他伸出手帮她起来。
words.en: If you hold out your hand or something you have in your hand, you move your hand away from your body, usually to offer something to someone else.

words.tr: phrase. v. 延期；延长（会议、假期等）；继续保留
words.ex: They decided to hold over the meeting until next week.
words.ex_cn: 他们决定将会议推迟到下周。
words.en: To postpone or delay something; to continue to use, show, or do something.

words.tr: phrase. 举起；支撑；继续下去；推举；阻挡；拦截；持械抢劫
words.ex: He held up his hand to ask a question.
words.ex_cn: 他举起了手来提问。
words.en: To hold something up means to keep it in a high position so that it does not fall or to support it. It can also mean to delay or stop the progress of something or someone, or to rob someone using violence or the threat of violence.

words.tr: phrase. v. 赞同，支持（某观点或做法）；通常用于否定句或疑问句，如 I don't hold with that（我不同意那种做法）
words.ex: I don't hold with the idea of working on weekends.
words.ex_cn: v. 我不同意周末工作的想法。
words.en: To agree with or support an idea, principle, or person.

words.ex: In a way, he is right about the problem.
words.ex_cn: 在某种程度上，他对这个问题的看法是正确的。
words.en: To some extent; from a certain point of view.

words.ex: In a sense, he is right.
words.ex_cn: 在某种意义上，他是对的。
words.en: You say in a sense to indicate that a statement is true in one way, but not in others.

words.tr: phrase. 在某种意义上；从一个角度来看
words.ex: In one sense, he is right.
words.ex_cn: 在某种意义上，他是对的。
words.en: From one particular point of view or interpretation.

words.ex: He has ten apples in all.
words.ex_cn: 他一共有十个苹果。
words.en: You use in all to emphasize that something is the total amount or number involved.

words.ex: In any case, we should proceed with the plan.
words.ex_cn: 无论如何，我们应该继续执行这个计划。
words.en: used to indicate that a statement explains or supports a previous statement; whatever the situation is or will be.

words.tr: phrase. 无论如何；不管怎样
words.ex: In any event, we will go to the park.
words.ex_cn: 无论如何，我们都会去公园。
words.en: Whatever happens or happened; in any case.

words.ex: Take an umbrella in case it rains.
words.ex_cn: 带把伞，以防下雨。
words.en: used to describe a situation where you do something in order to be prepared for a possible future event

words.tr: phrase. 假使；如果；万一；以防
words.ex: Keep a flashlight in case of power outage.
words.ex_cn: 以防停电，准备一个手电筒。
words.en: used to describe what should be done if a particular situation, especially a bad one, occurs

words.tr: adj. 受控制的；被监视的
words.ex: The suspect is currently incheck by the police.
words.ex_cn: 嫌疑人目前正受到警方的监视。
words.en: A misspelling or informal variant of 'in check,' meaning under control or in a state of restraint.

words.tr: phrase. 绝不；在任何情况下都不
words.ex: In no case should you give up your dreams.
words.ex_cn: 你绝不应该放弃你的梦想。
words.en: Under no circumstances; never.

words.tr: phrase. 绝不；一点也不；无论如何都不
words.ex: In no way should you feel responsible for what happened.
words.ex_cn: 你绝不应该对所发生的事情感到负责。
words.en: not at all; definitely not

words.ex: He went to school in spite of the rain.
words.ex_cn: 尽管下雨，他还是去上学了。
words.en: You use in spite of to introduce a fact which makes the rest of the statement you are making seem surprising.

words.ex: The box is in the way.
words.ex_cn: 这个箱子挡路了。
words.en: If something or someone is in the way, they prevent you from moving or from doing something.

words.tr: phrase. 挡某人的路；妨碍某人
words.ex: If you stand in my way, I'll have to ask you to move.
words.ex_cn: 如果你挡了我的道，我就得请你让开。
words.en: preventing someone from moving or acting freely; blocking someone's path or progress

words.ex: In the event of rain, the picnic will be moved to the gym.
words.ex_cn: 如果下雨，野餐将移到体育馆。
words.en: if something happens

words.ex: In the event that it rains, we will stay home.
words.ex_cn: 如果下雨，我们就待在家里。
words.en: If something happens; in case something happens.

words.tr: n. 事件；大事；比赛项目；
words.ex: The school event was fun for everyone.
words.ex_cn: 学校的活动对每个人都很有趣。
words.en: An event is something that happens, especially when it is unusual or important.

words.tr: phrase. 首先；从一开始；压根
words.ex: I didn't go out in the first place.
words.ex_cn: 我根本就没出去。
words.en: used at the beginning of a sentence to introduce the first of several reasons, facts, or points that you want to make

words.ex: In the long run, eating healthy saves money on doctor visits.
words.ex_cn: 从长远来看，健康饮食可以节省看医生的费用。
words.en: Over an extended period of time; in the future, especially in the distant future.

words.tr: phrase. 在短期内；从短期来看
words.ex: In the short run, the company will focus on increasing its market share.
words.ex_cn: 短期内，公司将专注于增加市场份额。
words.en: for a short period of time; in the near future

words.tr: phrase. 依次；轮流；结果；反过来
words.ex: The students spoke in turn to answer the teacher's question.
words.ex_cn: 学生们依次回答老师的问题。
words.en: You use in turn to refer to actions or events that are in a sequence one after the other, especially because one causes the other.

words.ex: He stayed home in view of the rain.
words.ex_cn: 由于下雨，他待在家里。
words.en: You use 'in view of' when you are taking into consideration a particular fact or situation that is important in relation to what you are saying or doing.

words.ex: He drank tea instead of coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他喝了茶，而不是咖啡。
words.en: In place of someone or something else.

words.ex: You need to keep at your studies if you want to pass the exam.
words.ex_cn: 如果你想通过考试，就需要坚持学习。
words.en: If you keep at something, you continue to do it or work on it, even though it is difficult or you are making slow progress.

words.tr: phrase. 阻止；抑制；隐瞒；留在后面
words.ex: He tried to keep back his tears.
words.ex_cn: 他试图忍住眼泪。
words.en: To retain or withhold something, not allowing it to be seen, known, or used.

words.ex: Please keep down the noise.
words.ex_cn: 请把噪音压低。
words.en: To prevent something from increasing, spreading, or becoming too noticeable.

words.ex: He tried to keep from crying.
words.ex_cn: 他努力忍住不哭。
words.en: To prevent someone from doing something or to not do something oneself.

words.ex: Keep off the grass.
words.ex_cn: 别踩草坪。
words.en: To avoid touching, stepping on, or coming into contact with something; to prevent someone or something from coming near or touching something.

words.ex: He keeps on walking even when he is tired.
words.ex_cn: 即使累了，他还是继续走。
words.en: If you keep on doing something, you continue to do it and do not stop.

words.ex: He keeps to his schedule every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都遵守自己的日程。
words.en: To continue to do something or to stay in a particular state or condition.

words.ex: He tries to keep up with his classmates.
words.ex_cn: 他努力跟上他的同学。
words.en: To keep up with something means to manage to do or have as much of it as is necessary or desirable, or to move at the same speed as someone or something else.

words.ex: He tries to keep up with his classmates.
words.ex_cn: 他努力跟上他的同学。
words.en: To continue to do something; to maintain something at a high level; to stay level or equal with someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 把……放在一边；搁置；储蓄；抛弃
words.ex: He lay aside his book and stood up.
words.ex_cn: 他把书放在一边，站了起来。
words.en: To put something to one side, especially for a short time, in order to do something else.

words.ex: The soldiers were ordered to lay down their arms.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们被命令放下武器。
words.en: To lay something down means to put it down, often in a careful or deliberate way. It can also mean to establish something, such as rules or guidelines.

words.ex: The company will lay off 50 workers next month.
words.ex_cn: 公司下个月将裁员50人。
words.en: To terminate the employment of a worker or workers, especially temporarily, because there is not enough work for them to do.

words.tr: phrase. 摆开；展示；布置；安排；投资
words.ex: He will lay out the books on the table.
words.ex_cn: 他将把书摆在桌子上。
words.en: To arrange or spread something out in a particular way, especially so that it can be seen or used easily.

words.tr: phrase. 中途停留；过夜；延期；推迟
words.ex: We had a lay over in Tokyo for six hours.
words.ex_cn: 我们在东京停留了六个小时。
words.en: To lay over means to stop somewhere for a short time before continuing a journey, or to cover something with a layer of material.

words.tr: phrase. v. 储存；使（船）入坞修理；使（人）卧床休养；暂停使用
words.ex: She decided to lay up some money for her retirement.
words.ex_cn: 她决定为退休储蓄一些钱。
words.en: To store or accumulate something for future use; to cause someone to be confined to bed due to illness or injury.

words.tr: phrase. 依靠…生活；以…为食；依赖…维持生计
words.ex: He lives off his parents because he has no job.
words.ex_cn: 他靠父母生活，因为他没有工作。
words.en: To live off something means to use it as your main source of income or sustenance.

words.tr: phrase. 继续生存； 以...为主食, 靠...生活
words.ex: The old man lives on small donations from neighbors.
words.ex_cn: 这位老人靠邻居们的小额捐款继续生存。
words.en: To continue to exist or be remembered; to have a particular type of food or income as one's main source of sustenance.

words.tr: phrase. 不住在工作地点；实践（梦想、幻想等）；度过（某段时间）
words.ex: He lives out in the city, not at the factory.
words.ex_cn: 他住在城里，而不是在工厂里。
words.en: If you live out your life in a particular way, you live in that way for the whole of your life.

words.tr: phrase. 经历…而幸存；度过（艰难时期）；经受住
words.ex: He lived through a big storm last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年经历了一场大风暴。
words.en: To experience and survive a difficult or dangerous situation.

words.tr: phrase. 不辜负；做到；实践（诺言等）
words.ex: He tried hard to live up to his father's expectations.
words.ex_cn: 他努力不辜负父亲的期望。
words.en: To perform as well as or achieve what is expected or promised.

words.tr: phrase. 与...一起住；接受并忍受
words.ex: He has to live with the noise from the street.
words.ex_cn: 他不得不忍受来自街道的噪音。
words.en: To tolerate or accept something unpleasant; to cohabit with someone.

words.tr: phrase. 向前看；为将来打算
words.ex: We need to look ahead and plan for the future.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要展望未来并为将来做计划。
words.en: To think about what will happen in the future and plan for it.

words.ex: He looks back on his childhood with happiness.
words.ex_cn: 他满怀幸福地回忆自己的童年。
words.en: To look back means to think about something that happened in the past.

words.ex: He looks down on people who work hard.
words.ex_cn: 他瞧不起努力工作的人。
words.en: To regard someone or something as inferior or unworthy of respect.

words.ex: Some people look down upon others who have less money.
words.ex_cn: 有些人瞧不起那些钱少的人。
words.en: To regard someone or something as inferior or unworthy of respect.

words.tr: phrase. 调查；研究；观察；检查
words.ex: The police will look into the accident.
words.ex_cn: 警察将调查这起事故。
words.en: If you look into a problem or matter, you investigate it or examine it.

words.ex: I will look in on my grandma after work.
words.ex_cn: 我下班后会去看望我奶奶。
words.en: To make a brief visit or inspection.

words.tr: phrase. 观看；面向；旁观；看待
words.ex: They look on while the children play.
words.ex_cn: 他们看着孩子们玩耍。
words.en: To watch something happen without getting involved.

words.ex: Look out the window to see the birds.
words.ex_cn: 往窗外看，看看那些鸟。
words.en: To be vigilant or cautious.

words.tr: phrase. 当心；留心；寻找；照料
words.ex: Look out for the dog when you walk by.
words.ex_cn: 你经过时要当心那只狗。
words.en: To be vigilant or attentive; to watch for something or someone.

words.tr: phrase. 察看；检查；翻阅；原谅；从...上面看
words.ex: He will look over his homework before bed.
words.ex_cn: 他睡觉前会检查一下作业。
words.en: To examine or inspect something quickly or casually.

words.ex: He looked through the book quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他快速翻阅了那本书。
words.en: To look through something means to examine or read it quickly or casually.

words.ex: You must look to your health before it's too late.
words.ex_cn: 你必须注意你的健康，趁还来得及。
words.en: To expect or depend on someone or something to do something or provide something.

words.ex: I look up the word in the dictionary.
words.ex_cn: 我在字典里查这个词。
words.en: If you look up a fact or a piece of information, you find it by looking in something such as a reference book or a list.

words.ex: He made for the door when he heard the alarm.
words.ex_cn: 他听到警报后走向了门。
words.en: If something makes for a particular situation, it causes that situation to exist or develop.

words.tr: phrase. 及时到达；达到预定目标
words.ex: We need to leave now to make it to the train on time.
words.ex_cn: 我们现在必须出发，才能及时赶到火车。
words.en: To succeed in arriving at a place or achieving a goal.

words.ex: He made off after stealing the bike.
words.ex_cn: 他偷了自行车后就离开了。
words.en: To leave quickly, especially in order to escape or avoid something; to steal something and leave quickly.

words.tr: phrase. 理解；看待；解释（某事）
words.ex: I don't make of what he said.
words.ex_cn: 我不理解他所说的话。
words.en: To interpret or understand something in a particular way.

words.tr: phrase. 前往；费力前进；取得成功；闯出一条路
words.ex: The boy makes his way to school every morning.
words.ex_cn: 这个男孩每天早上步行去上学。
words.en: To move or travel towards a destination, especially when this is difficult or takes a long time.

words.tr: phrase. 理解；辨认出；书写；进展；设法应付；亲热
words.ex: I can't make out the words in this small print.
words.ex_cn: 我看不清这些小字。
words.en: to manage to see, hear, or understand someone or something with difficulty

words.tr: phrase. 讲得通； 有意义； 言之有理
words.ex: This plan makes sense.
words.ex_cn: 这个计划有道理。
words.en: To be reasonable or understandable.

words.ex: He worked extra hours to make up for the lost time.
words.ex_cn: 他加班工作来弥补失去的时间。
words.en: To compensate for something that is lacking or has been lost.

words.tr: phrase. 编造；组成；弥补；化妆；和好
words.ex: He made up a story to explain his delay.
words.ex_cn: 他编了一个故事来解释他的迟到。
words.en: To make up means to form something by combining or assembling parts, to invent a story or excuse, to apply cosmetics, or to reconcile after a disagreement.

words.ex: The crowd made way for the ambulance.
words.ex_cn: 人群为救护车让路。
words.en: To move aside or to allow someone or something to pass by.

words.ex: Much as I admire her courage, I think she is reckless.
words.ex_cn: 尽管我佩服她的勇气，我认为她太鲁莽了。
words.en: Although; even though.

words.tr: phrase. 绝不；没门；不可能；表示强烈否定或惊讶
words.ex: No way will I eat that food.
words.ex_cn: 我绝不会吃那种食物。
words.en: used to say that there is no possibility that you will do something or that something will happen

words.ex: Not to speak of the cost, it took us a whole day to finish the project.
words.ex_cn: 更不用说成本了，我们花了整整一天时间才完成这个项目。
words.en: used to emphasize that something is even more unlikely or difficult than the thing you have just mentioned

words.ex: Now that it is sunny, we can go outside.
words.ex_cn: 既然天晴了，我们可以出去了。
words.en: Used to introduce a reason or explanation, often implying that the situation has changed.

words.tr: phrase. 在逃；匆忙地；奔波；不停地移动
words.ex: He has been on the run since the bank heist.
words.ex_cn: 自从银行抢劫案以来，他一直在逃亡。
words.en: If someone is on the run, they are trying to avoid being captured by the police, often by moving from place to place.

words.tr: phrase. 除了…以外；不包括；绝不是
words.ex: He eats vegetables other than potatoes.
words.ex_cn: 他吃蔬菜，但不吃土豆。
words.en: You use 'other than' after a negative statement to say that the person, item, or thing that follows is the only exception to the statement.

words.tr: phrase. 在偏僻处；不碍事；罕见
words.ex: The old shed is out of the way, behind the hill.
words.ex_cn: 那个旧棚子在山后面，很偏僻。
words.en: If something is out of the way, it is not blocking a path or is in a remote or isolated location.

words.ex: My grandfather passed away last year.
words.ex_cn: 我祖父去年去世了。
words.en: If someone passes away, they die.

words.tr: phrase. 冒充；把…冒充为；顺利举行；逐渐消失
words.ex: He tried to pass off as a doctor.
words.ex_cn: 他试图冒充医生。
words.en: To happen or occur; to represent something falsely; to gradually disappear.

words.tr:
v. 通过；传递；路过；(时间)流逝；
n. 通行证；(考试)及格；
words.ex: He passed the exam with a high score.
words.ex_cn: 他以高分通过了考试。
words.en: To move or go past someone or something; to transfer or hand over something to someone.

words.ex: He will pass on the message to his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他会把消息转告给他的朋友。
words.en: To give something to someone else, especially after receiving it or using it; to continue moving forward; to die.

words.tr: phrase. 昏倒；失去知觉；（军队中）分发；散发
words.ex: He felt dizzy and started to pass out.
words.ex_cn: 他感到头晕，开始昏倒。
words.en: If someone passes out, they become unconscious for a short time, often because they are tired, ill, or have drunk too much alcohol. It can also mean to distribute something to a group of people.

words.tr: phrase. 跨过；忽视；不予理会
words.ex: He passed over the small stream on the log.
words.ex_cn: 他从木头上跨过了那条小溪。
words.en: To ignore or disregard someone or something; to move across or beyond something.

words.ex: Don't pass up this opportunity; it may never come again.
words.ex_cn: 不要错过这个机会；它可能再也不会来了。
words.en: To choose not to take advantage of an opportunity.

words.ex: He can pick out his toy from the box.
words.ex_cn: 他能从盒子里挑出他的玩具。
words.en: To choose someone or something from a group.

words.tr: phrase. 捡起；获得；接人；恢复精神；偶然学到；加速；逮住
words.ex: He picked up the pen from the floor.
words.ex_cn: 他从地上捡起了钢笔。
words.en: If you pick something up, you lift it up from a surface. If you pick someone up, you go to the place where they are and take them away, often in a car. If you pick up a skill or an idea, you acquire it without formal teaching or training. If something picks up, it improves or increases after a period of inactivity or decline.

words.tr: phrase. 拆开；撕碎；使分离；严厉批评
words.ex: The children were excited to pull apart the new toy to see how it worked.
words.ex_cn: v. 孩子们兴奋地拆开新玩具，想看看它是如何工作的。
words.en: To separate something into pieces by pulling; to analyze something in detail.

words.tr: phrase. 驶离；离开；脱身；拉开距离
words.ex: The car started to pull away from the bus stop.
words.ex_cn: 汽车开始从公交站开走了。
words.en: To move away or depart, especially in a vehicle; to create distance between oneself and someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 拆毁（建筑物）；拉下；降低（价格、水平等）
words.ex: They pull down the old house to build a new school.
words.ex_cn: 他们拆掉旧房子来建一所新学校。
words.en: To pull down something means to destroy it or remove it from its position.

words.ex: The bus pulls in at the station every ten minutes.
words.ex_cn: 公交车每十分钟进站一次。
words.en: To attract or earn money; to arrest someone; (of a vehicle) to move into a particular place or to stop at a station.

words.tr: phrase. 成功完成（困难的事）；脱下；扯掉；把车驶离（道路）
words.ex: She managed to pull off a surprise party for her husband.
words.ex_cn: 她成功地为丈夫举办了一个惊喜派对。
words.en: To succeed in doing something difficult or tricky.

words.tr: phrase. 拔出；驶离路边；退出
words.ex: He pulled out a coin from his pocket.
words.ex_cn: 他从口袋里掏出了一枚硬币。
words.en: To remove something or someone from a place or situation.

words.tr: phrase. （把车）靠边停下；靠边停车
words.ex: The police told him to pull over.
words.ex_cn: 警察让他靠边停车。
words.en: To move a vehicle to the side of the road and stop, especially when instructed by the police.

words.tr: phrase. 渡过难关；恢复健康；使脱离险境
words.ex: With the support of his family, he managed to pull through the difficult times.
words.ex_cn: 在家人的支持下，他成功渡过了难关。
words.en: To survive a difficult or dangerous situation; to recover from an illness.

words.ex: They pull together to finish the project on time.
words.ex_cn: 他们齐心协力按时完成项目。
words.en: To work together as a team or group in order to achieve something.

words.ex: He pulled up the weed from the garden.
words.ex_cn: 他把杂草从花园里拔了出来。
words.en: To pull up means to bring something to a higher position or to stop moving.

words.tr: phrase. 使被理解；把…讲清楚；成功地表达（想法、观点等）
words.ex: He tried to put across his idea clearly.
words.ex_cn: 他试图清楚地表达他的想法。
words.en: To communicate something clearly and effectively to someone.

words.tr: phrase. v. 使被理解；成功传达（想法、信息等）；推迟；延期
words.ex: He put over the message clearly.
words.ex_cn: 他清楚地传达了那个信息。
words.en: To successfully communicate an idea or message to someone, or to postpone something to a later time.

words.tr: phrase. 搁置一旁；保留；储存...备用
words.ex: He put aside his money for the trip.
words.ex_cn: 他把钱存起来用于旅行。
words.en: To place something to one side; to save something for future use.

words.tr: phrase. 收起来；杀死；关进监狱；放弃
words.ex: He put away his toys after playing.
words.ex_cn: 他玩完后把玩具收起来了。
words.en: To put something away means to place it in its proper storage location, to save or store it, to consume it, or to confine someone in prison.

words.tr: phrase. 放进；插入；提出；提交；使就职；进港
words.ex: Put in the keys before you leave.
words.ex_cn: 离开前把钥匙放进去。
words.en: To place something inside or into a particular position or location.

words.ex: He put off his homework until tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他把作业推迟到明天。
words.en: To delay something or to cause someone to feel dislike or lack of interest.

words.tr: phrase. 穿戴；上演；增加（体重）
words.ex: He puts on his coat before going out.
words.ex_cn: 他出门前穿上外套。
words.en: To put on something means to dress oneself in it, or to start wearing it. It can also mean to produce a play, show, or other performance. Additionally, it can refer to gaining weight or to pretend to have a particular feeling or quality.

words.tr: phrase. 扑灭；熄掉；伸出；发表；恼怒
words.ex: He put out the fire with a blanket.
words.ex_cn: 他用毯子扑灭了火。
words.en: To extinguish a fire or light; to publish or produce something; to extend or stretch out something.

words.ex: He was put through a tough training program.
words.ex_cn: 他经受了一项严格的训练计划。
words.en: To cause someone to experience something, especially something difficult or unpleasant, or to connect a telephone call.

words.ex: I can't put up with his loud noise every night.
words.ex_cn: 我无法忍受他每晚的噪音。
words.en: To tolerate or endure something unpleasant or annoying.

words.tr: phrase. 举起；张贴；建造；进行；提供；推举；提供食宿
words.ex: He put up his hand to ask a question.
words.ex_cn: 他举起了手来提问。
words.en: To provide someone with a place to stay temporarily; to build or erect something; to raise or lift something; to propose or suggest something; to display or post something; to increase the price of something.

words.tr: phrase. 宁可 ... 也不愿；与其 ... 倒不如；而不是
words.ex: He chose to walk rather than take the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他宁愿走路也不愿坐公交车。
words.en: used to say that one thing is preferred to another or happens instead of another

words.ex: He went for a walk regardless of the rain.
words.ex_cn: 尽管下雨，他还是去散步了。
words.en: Without taking into account; without being affected by.

words.ex: He ruled out the wrong answer on the test.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试中划去了错误的答案。
words.en: To decide that something is not possible or not worth considering.

words.ex: I run across my old friend at the market.
words.ex_cn: 我在市场遇到了我的老朋友。
words.en: To meet or find someone or something by chance.

words.tr: phrase. 与…私奔；轻易赢得；失去控制；携…逃跑
words.ex: He wants to run away with his friend to the beach.
words.ex_cn: 他想和朋友一起逃跑到海滩。
words.en: To leave a place or person secretly and suddenly, especially to get married without the permission of one's parents; to win something easily; to lose control of something.

words.tr: phrase. 跑进；撞上；偶遇；陷入；达到
words.ex: The dog ran into the house.
words.ex_cn: 狗跑进了房子。
words.en: To meet someone or find something by chance; to experience something unexpectedly; to collide with something.

words.tr: phrase. 逃跑； 流掉；迅速离开
words.ex: The boy ran off with his brother's bike.
words.ex_cn: 那个男孩骑着他哥哥的自行车跑掉了。
words.en: To leave a place or situation quickly and secretly, often to avoid a problem or responsibility; to produce copies of a document quickly; to discharge or release a liquid.

words.tr: phrase. 用完；耗尽；跑出去；到期
words.ex: We run out of milk every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 我们每星期天都把牛奶喝光了。
words.en: If you run out of something, you have no more of it left.

words.ex: We ran out of milk this morning.
words.ex_cn: 我们今天早上牛奶喝完了。
words.en: If you run out of something, you have no more of it left.

words.tr: phrase. 碾过；溢出；匆匆浏览；超过（时间、数量等）
words.ex: The car ran over a small stone on the road.
words.ex_cn: 汽车碾过了路上的一块小石头。
words.en: To hit someone or something with a vehicle and drive over them; to quickly look through or read something; to overflow.

words.tr: phrase. 跑着穿过；刺、戳；贯穿；匆匆处理；排练；划掉；挥霍
words.ex: The dog ran through the park quickly.
words.ex_cn: 狗迅速跑过了公园。
words.en: To go over or examine something quickly; to be present in every part of something; to rehearse a play, piece of music, etc.

words.tr: phrase. 达到（某数量或程度）；求助于；有能力支付；匆匆前往
words.ex: The children run to the park every morning.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们每天早上都跑向公园。
words.en: To move quickly on foot so that both feet leave the ground during each stride; to go to someone for help or support.

words.tr: phrase. 遭遇；碰到（困难、障碍等）
words.ex: He run up against some problems when he tried to start the car.
words.ex_cn: 当他试图启动汽车时，遇到了一些问题。
words.en: To encounter or face difficulties or opposition unexpectedly.

words.tr: phrase. v. 迅速累积（债务、账单等）；匆匆赶制；升起（旗帜等）；助跑
words.ex: He ran up a big bill at the store.
words.ex_cn: 他在商店里赊账欠下了一大笔钱。
words.en: To accumulate or increase something, especially debts or costs, quickly.

words.tr: phrase. 一定注意到；务必使
words.ex: I see that you're trying to cheat again, and I won't let it happen.
words.ex_cn: 我注意到你又在试图作弊，我不会让它发生的。
words.en: To ensure or verify that something is the case.

words.tr: phrase. 务必确保；负责使…发生（或完成）
words.ex: See to it that the door is locked.
words.ex_cn: 确保门锁好了。
words.en: To make sure that something is done or happens.

words.tr: phrase. v. 处理；安排；照料（某事）
words.ex: I will see about the meeting time.
words.ex_cn: 我会去确认一下会议时间。
words.en: To attend to or deal with something.

words.ex: We went to the station to see off our friend.
words.ex_cn: 我们去车站为朋友送行。
words.en: To accompany someone to the point of departure, such as an airport, train station, etc., as a gesture of farewell.

words.tr: phrase. v. 送某人到门口；陪伴某人至结束；完成（某事）
words.ex: I will see you out after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 晚饭后我会送你到门口。
words.en: To continue with a task or project until it is completed, despite difficulties or the time it takes; to accompany someone to the door when they are leaving.

words.ex: I can see through his lie.
words.ex_cn: 我看穿了他的谎言。
words.en: To perceive the true nature of someone or something, especially their deceitfulness or the real situation. Also, to support someone or something until the end of a difficult situation.

words.ex: I will see to the children while you are away.
words.ex_cn: 你不在的时候，我会照看孩子们。
words.en: To attend to or take care of something.

words.tr: v. 看；“see”的现在分词；领悟； conj. 鉴于；
words.ex: I am seeing the bird in the tree.
words.ex_cn: 我正在看树上的鸟。
words.en: the ability to see; the act of perceiving with the eyes

words.ex: Seeing that it's raining, we should take an umbrella.
words.ex_cn: 鉴于下雨了，我们应该带伞。
words.en: used to introduce a reason or explanation for something

words.tr: phrase. 派遣离开；打发走；寄出
words.ex: He sent away the noisy guests.
words.ex_cn: 他把那些吵闹的客人送走了。
words.en: To cause something to go or be taken to a place, especially by post or by a messenger.

words.tr: phrase. 派人去叫；派人去请；派人去取
words.ex: He will send for a doctor tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会请医生过来。
words.en: To ask or order that someone or something be brought to you, especially by sending a message.

words.tr: phrase. 派遣；提交；呈送（如文件、申请等）
words.ex: The army will send in troops to help.
words.ex_cn: 军队将派遣部队去帮忙。
words.en: To submit or deliver something, typically a document or application, to a particular place or person.

words.tr: phrase. 送行；寄出；解雇；（足球中）罚下场
words.ex: The company held a ceremony to send off the retiring CEO.
words.ex_cn: 公司为即将退休的CEO举行了一场送别仪式。
words.en: To dispatch someone or something to a destination, or to bid farewell to someone who is leaving.

words.ex: He sends out emails every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上发送邮件。
words.en: To cause something to go or be taken to a place, especially by post or by email.

words.tr: phrase. 送上去；发射；嘲笑，讽刺（尤指模仿某人或某事以取笑）
words.ex: The students like to send up the teacher with funny voices.
words.ex_cn: 学生们喜欢用滑稽的声音模仿老师。
words.en: To launch or propel something upwards; to mock or parody someone or something in a humorous way.

words.ex: He set about cleaning the room after breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他吃完早餐后开始打扫房间。
words.en: To start doing something, especially something that needs a lot of effort or time.

words.tr: phrase. 反对；与…相对；以…为背景
words.ex: He set against the new policy because it hurt the poor.
words.ex_cn: 他反对这项新政策，因为它伤害了穷人。
words.en: If you set one thing against another, you consider it in relation to another thing, especially in order to show how they are different or to decide which is better.

words.tr: phrase. 区分；留出；使与众不同
words.ex: His kindness sets him apart from others.
words.ex_cn: 他的善良使他与众不同。
words.en: To distinguish someone or something as different from others; to reserve or allocate something for a specific purpose.

words.tr: phrase. 放置一旁；留出；不理会；取消
words.ex: He sets aside $50 each week for savings.
words.ex_cn: 他每周存下50美元作为储蓄。
words.en: To reserve or keep something for a particular purpose or person.

words.tr: phrase. 阻碍；延缓；使受挫折；回拨（钟表）
words.ex: The storm set back the construction by two weeks.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴把施工推迟了两周。
words.en: To delay or hinder the progress of something.

words.tr: phrase. 制定；（使）放下；（叫…）下车；记下
words.ex: The government set down new rules for safety.
words.ex_cn: 政府制定了新的安全规则。
words.en: To place something on a surface or to write or record something officially.

words.tr: phrase. 阐明；提出；陈列；出发；把…提前
words.ex: He set forth his ideas clearly.
words.ex_cn: 他清楚地提出了自己的想法。
words.en: To present or introduce something, such as an idea, plan, or argument, in a clear and detailed way.

words.ex: The rain set in after lunch.
words.ex_cn: 午饭后雨开始下了。
words.en: If something sets in, especially something unpleasant, it begins and seems likely to continue or develop.

words.tr: phrase. 出发；动身；使爆炸；引起
words.ex: He set off early to avoid traffic.
words.ex_cn: 他早早出发以避开交通拥堵。
words.en: To begin a journey or to cause something to start or happen.

words.ex: The dog set on the intruder.
words.ex_cn: 狗攻击了入侵者。
words.en: To cause someone or something to attack or confront someone or something else.

words.tr: phrase. 动身； 出发；着手；陈述
words.ex: They set out early to catch the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他们早早出发去赶公交车。
words.en: To begin a journey or to start doing something with a particular aim.

words.tr: phrase. 建立；创立；设立；架起；提出
words.ex: He set up a small shop last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年开了一家小商店。
words.en: To set up something means to establish it or arrange it.

words.ex: So far, he has finished his homework.
words.ex_cn: 到目前为止，他已经完成了作业。
words.en: Up to the present moment; until now.

words.tr: phrase. 支持；遵守；袖手旁观；准备行动
words.ex: I will stand by you when you face difficulties.
words.ex_cn: 当你遇到困难时，我会支持你。
words.en: To be ready to support or act if needed; to wait in a state of readiness.

words.tr: phrase. 离开法庭的证人席；退出比赛；解散
words.ex: The witness was told to stand down after answering the questions.
words.ex_cn: 证人在回答完问题后被要求离开证人席。
words.en: To withdraw or resign from a position or office; to cease to be on duty or alert.

words.tr: phrase. 代表；象征；支持；容忍
words.ex: The letter A stands for apple.
words.ex_cn: 字母A代表苹果。
words.en: If you say that a letter stands for a particular word, you mean that it is an abbreviation for that word.

words.tr: phrase. 代替；代表；做替身；使花费
words.ex: Tom will stand in for the manager while she is away.
words.ex_cn: 当经理离开时，汤姆将代替她。
words.en: To temporarily take someone's place or perform their duties.

words.tr: phrase. 引人注目；突出；出色
words.ex: Her red hat makes her stand out in the crowd.
words.ex_cn: 她的红帽子让她在人群中很显眼。
words.en: To be very noticeable or obvious, especially in comparison to others.

words.tr: phrase. 支持；捍卫；为…挺身而出
words.ex: He will stand up for his friend when others are mean.
words.ex_cn: 当别人对他的朋友刻薄时，他会为朋友挺身而出。
words.en: To support or defend someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. v. 抵抗；勇敢面对；经得起（考验或压力）
words.ex: He stood up to the bully and helped his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他勇敢地对抗欺负人的孩子，帮助了他的朋友。
words.en: To confront someone or something in a brave or determined way.

words.ex: The students stand up when the teacher enters the classroom.
words.ex_cn: 当老师走进教室时，学生们站起来。
words.en: If you stand up, you rise to your feet from a sitting or lying position.

words.ex: We start off early to avoid traffic.
words.ex_cn: 我们早早出发以避开交通拥堵。
words.en: To begin a journey, activity, or process.

words.tr: phrase. v. 开始做（某事）；着手处理；对…发起攻击或责备
words.ex: He will start on his homework after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭后会开始做作业。
words.en: To begin to do something.

words.tr: phrase. 开始；出发；起初从事（某事）
words.ex: He starts out as a teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他一开始是一名老师。
words.en: To begin a journey or a process.

words.ex: He wants to start up a small coffee shop.
words.ex_cn: 他想开一家小咖啡店。
words.en: To start up means to begin or initiate something, such as a business or a project.

words.tr: phrase. 使吃惊；使意外；使措手不及
words.ex: The sudden noise took her aback.
words.ex_cn: 突然的响声让她大吃一惊。
words.en: To surprise or shock someone so much that they do not know how to react.

words.ex: He takes after his father in looks.
words.ex_cn: 他在长相上像他父亲。
words.en: If you take after a member of your family, you resemble them in your appearance, your behaviour, or your character.

words.ex: He took apart the clock to see how it works.
words.ex_cn: 他把钟表拆开来看它是如何工作的。
words.en: To separate something into its different parts, especially in order to repair it or to understand how it works.

words.tr: phrase. 拿回；收回；取消；使回忆起
words.ex: I will take back my book from the library.
words.ex_cn: 我会从图书馆拿回我的书。
words.en: To take something back means to return something to the place it came from, or to admit that something you said was wrong.

words.tr: phrase. 拆卸；拆毁；记录；记下；笔录；取下
words.ex: He took down the old photo from the wall.
words.ex_cn: 他把墙上的旧照片取了下来。
